messages.content: List my incomplete todos.

outputs.reference: A short summary of incomplete todos from the API (titles and ids).

messages.content: Show all my todos.

outputs.reference: Lists todos (any status) returned by the API.

messages.content: Show my completed todos.

outputs.reference: Lists completed todos from the API.

messages.content: Which todos are overdue?

outputs.reference: Reports overdue items from list_todos with status overdue.

messages.content: Add a todo titled Buy milk.

outputs.reference: Confirms creation of a todo titled Buy milk and includes its todoId.

messages.content: Create a todo: Call dentist, due 2030-01-15.

outputs.reference: Confirms a todo Call dentist with due date 2030-01-15.

messages.content: Add a todo titled Pick up dry cleaning, due tomorrow.

outputs.reference: Creates a todo Pick up dry cleaning with an ISO dueDate for tomorrow relative to today.

messages.content: Mark todo todo-abc as complete.

outputs.reference: Completes the todo with id todo-abc and confirms.

messages.content: Mark todo todo-abc as incomplete.

outputs.reference: Marks todo-abc incomplete and confirms.

messages.content: Rename todo todo-abc to Buy oat milk.

outputs.reference: Updates todo-abc title to Buy oat milk.

messages.content: Delete todo todo-abc.

outputs.reference: Deletes todo-abc and confirms.

messages.content: What is the capital of France?

outputs.reference: Declines or briefly redirects without calling todo tools; explains it only handles todos.

messages.content: Tell me what's on my todo list for this week.

outputs.reference: Explains it cannot filter todos by calendar week (no week/due-range tool). May suggest listing all, incomplete, or overdue instead. Must not invent a week filter or claim it listed only this week. No todo tools.

messages.content: Show todos due between 2030-03-01 and 2030-03-07.

outputs.reference: Explains there is no due-date range filter; may suggest overdue/all/incomplete lists instead. Does not claim a precise range filter. No todo tools.
